description: The CLI can create invitations but cannot list or revoke them: `client invites` → INVALID_ARGUMENT usage list. An agent asked to "check tomorrow whether he used it" must ask a human to open the browser dialog.
expected: `client invites --project ID` and `client invite-revoke` (or `client revoke --kind invite`).
suggested_fix: Add CLI wrappers over the existing GET /invites and POST /invites/:id/revoke routes.

description: The history list is unbounded and oldest-first. With 20 invites the whole dialog scrolls (scrollHeight 1161 vs clientHeight 866 at 1440x900); title, Close and Create invitation scroll out of view and the newest invite is at the very bottom.
expected: History scrolls inside its own region (or paginates), newest first, with the dialog header fixed.
actual: Whole-dialog scroll to reach the newest row.
suggested_fix: Cap the list height with overflow:auto, reverse the order, collapse non-issued rows.

description: CLI output: expiresAt is a raw epoch in ms (1794338581508); every command prints Node's "ExperimentalWarning: SQLite is an experimental feature" on stderr; failures print the error twice (JSON line plus "CODE: message").
expected: ISO timestamp, no Node warnings, one error representation per stream.
suggested_fix: Format expiresAt as ISO, suppress the SQLite warning, print the plain line only to stderr.

description: When re-running the original invite command after a browser revoke returns REVOKED "Invitation revoked", the previously written --output-file with the dead invitation stays on disk and the CLI does not mention it.
expected: Mention the stale file (or remove it) on REVOKED.
suggested_fix: Add a hint to the REVOKED output.
